assumptions.statement: Official precise boundaries, regulatory controls, road redlines, parcel ownership, municipal utilities, fire, heritage and engineering constraints are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves remain conceptual suggestions and must be rebuilt against official material before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry derived from public text and announced approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: They support package generation and topology checks only; they are not official redlines, parcel boundaries or precise area evidence.

assumptions.statement: Land-use polygons are a complete conceptual functional partition created to test the design logic and validation pipeline.
assumptions.impact: Calculated ratios describe the submitted concept layer only and are not existing-condition or statutory land-use ratios.

assumptions.statement: The building polygon is a conceptual intervention envelope, not a surveyed building inventory or approved footprint.
assumptions.impact: Its recomputed area cannot support demolition, retention, floor-area, height or investment conclusions.

assumptions.statement: East-west barriers are a documented issue, but no bridge, tunnel, crossing or detailed route is assumed feasible.
assumptions.impact: Crossings are framed as audit and option-comparison tasks pending transport, rail, utility, accessibility and cost studies.

assumptions.statement: Low-speed robotics is considered only in bounded time-space windows with an operator, safety officer, physical stop, insurance and incident log.
assumptions.impact: No citywide or unattended robot route is proposed.

assumptions.statement: Public data, personal data and institutional data are not presumed available merely because a scenario is open source.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot requires purpose limitation, minimum necessary data, authorization, retention and deletion rules, human review and redress.

assumptions.statement: Open Works Guild is a proposed coordination layer; government bodies, owners and professional operators have not committed to operate any element.
assumptions.impact: No programme, event, service level, procurement or funding is presented as a government commitment.

assumptions.statement: Official information supports a Haidian-Zhangjiakou compute collaboration direction, but the package has no verified bandwidth, latency, green-electricity share, carbon or service-capacity data.
assumptions.impact: Regional compute is retained as an interface direction with no quantified performance claim.

assumptions.statement: No investment estimate or construction schedule is made without quantities, ownership, design depth, market prices, approvals and delivery responsibility.
assumptions.impact: Implementation is expressed as work packages, prerequisites, acceptance conditions and exit rules rather than fabricated cost and programme figures.
